name: USPW World Championship
epitaph: USPW's top belt. Bruce the Giant holds it when the diary opens and loses it to Freddie Datsun at Stars, Stripes and Slams in January 2007; Datsun defends it against William Hayes, Peter Valentine and Umaga into March, with a burst appendix after Bruce's chokeslam off the stage keeping him out for part of February. Umaga takes the belt from Datsun in a steel cage match on the third show of March 2007, keeps it against Datsun, Trent Shaffer, Muffin and Datsun again through the end of May, and is set to defend it against Triple D at the diary's first Family Night. Umaga beats Muffin on the fourth Saturday of May 2007 and keeps the belt in June against Triple D at the first Family Night, Freddie Datsun and Triple D again on the fourth Family Night, still champion at the end of June 2007. Umaga keeps the belt against William Hayes at the Family Night of Thursday, Week 4, July 2007 and loses it to Darryl Devine in a steel cage match at the Family Night of Friday, Week 1, August 2007; Devine is champion at the end of the diary's second week of August. Darryl Devine keeps the belt against Bruce the Giant in August 2007, against William Hayes at Summer of Love, which the narrator calls the best match in his history, and against Freddie Datsun and Jim Force in September; he is champion in the first half of Blaze of Glory, where Muffin is set to challenge him. Darryl Devine keeps the belt against Muffin at Blaze of Glory in September 2007, in a match restarted after the referee counted her pin, and beats her down in a cage match on the Monday of Week 4; he is champion at the end of the range, set to defend it against Sam Strong at A Haunting in America. In October 2007 Darryl Devine keeps the belt against Frankie Perez, Bruce the Giant, Sam Strong, back from retirement at A Haunting in America, and Davey Wayne; Freddie Datsun wins the number one contendership and takes the belt away from him in a brawl on the Thursday of Week 3, and the two are set to meet at Pilgrimage on 22 November 2007. In November 2007 Darryl Devine keeps the belt against Umaga on the Monday of Week 1, in a match the narrator rates an A*, and against Freddie Datsun at Pilgrimage, when the Masked Man hits Datsun and Danny Jillefski counts the pin; he is champion at the end of the range. Through December 2007 Darryl Devine is still champion with no title match booked; the Masked Man is revealed as Jack Giedroyc on the Thursday of Week 2 and is booked against him at Winter Epiphany.

name: USPW National Championship
epitaph: The belt Jim Force holds when the diary opens and loses to Citizen X in January 2007. Citizen X keeps it through five defenses by the end of the range, two of them against Force. Steve Flash takes the belt from Citizen X on the third show of March 2007 and keeps it through the April and May shows against Fumihiro Ota, Corporal Doom and William Hayes, with a defense against Hayes set for the first Family Night. William Hayes takes the belt from Steve Flash in a two out of three falls match at the first Family Night, Friday of Week 1, June 2007, and keeps it in June against Art Reed, Freddie Datsun, Muffin and Wanda Fish. William Hayes keeps the belt against Jacob Jett in July 2007 and against Wanda Fish in August. William Hayes keeps the belt against Bulldozer Brandon Smith and Art Reed in August 2007 and against Rudy Velasquez in September; Wanda Fish is set to challenge him at Blaze of Glory. William Hayes loses the belt to Wanda Fish at Blaze of Glory in September 2007, by disqualification when Triple D hits Fish with it; Fish is champion at the end of the range, with Jacob Jett set to challenge her at A Haunting in America. Wanda Fish keeps the belt against Jacob Jett at A Haunting in America in October 2007; Fish, Jett and Art Reed are booked into a three-way for Pilgrimage. Wanda Fish keeps the belt at Pilgrimage in November 2007 by pinning Art Reed in the three-way with Reed and Jacob Jett; she is champion at the end of the range. In December 2007 Wanda Fish is still champion; Phlex, her new boyfriend, is booked as her challenger for Winter Epiphany.

name: USPW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The pair of belts The Towers of Power hold until the third show of the diary. They pass to The Dudez!!!1! in January 2007, then to the Canadian Crusties a week later, who defend them against the Lords of War in March. The Dudez!!!1! win the belts back in a three-way match on the third show of March 2007 and keep them against The Demons of Rage and Veteran Mentality, with another defense against the Demons of Rage set for the first Family Night. The Dudez!!!1! keep the belts in June 2007 against the Demons of Rage at the first Family Night and Veteran Mentality at the fourth; Trent Shaffer then carries the belts off after a chair attack, and the diary records no change of champions. The Dudez!!!1! beat Trent Shaffer and Chance Fortune, billed as the dudes, at the Family Night of Thursday, Week 3, July 2007 and take the belts back from the pair, and beat them again in August. Team Seduction, Human Arsenal and Fumihiro Ota with Seduction, take the belts from The Dudez!!!1! at Summer of Love in August 2007; the Dudez are given a rematch, set as a ladder match for Blaze of Glory. Team Seduction keep the belts against The Dudez!!!1! in a ladder match at Blaze of Glory in September 2007; Veteran Mentality are named the #1 contenders for A Haunting in America. Team Seduction keep the belts against Veteran Mentality at A Haunting in America in October 2007. The Valentines take the belts from Team Seduction at Pilgrimage in November 2007 when Triple D turns on Human Arsenal, and lose them minutes later to Divinity's new members The Hotshots, who keep them against The Valentines on the Monday of Week 3. The Hotshots keep the belts against Veteran Mentality on the Thursday of Week 4, November 2007 and against The Dudez!!!1!!! on the Thursday of Week 1, December 2007; Maxmillion Productions are booked against them at Winter Epiphany.

name: USPW Unappreciated Championship
epitaph: A belt the card for Blaze of Glory bills in September 2007 as the "USPW Unappreciated Championship", fought for in a four-way between Bulldozer Brandon Smith, Brett Hall, "The Trademark" Thomas Morgan and Insane Machine, the lower-card wrestlers the narrator says the crowd could not care less about. Bulldozer Brandon Smith wins the match in the first half of the show, and the diary names no earlier holder. Bulldozer Brandon Smith draws with Brett Hall by double disqualification in September 2007 and beats Brendan Idol in October; Hall is set to challenge him at A Haunting in America. Bulldozer Brandon Smith keeps the belt against Brendan Idol and Insane Machine and against Brett Hall in a street fight at A Haunting in America in October 2007; Idol earns a Pilgrimage challenge by beating Hall on the Monday of Week 3. Bulldozer Brandon Smith keeps the belt against Brendan Idol at Pilgrimage in November 2007 with a Backdrop Driver; he is champion at the end of the range. Bulldozer Brandon Smith beats Mean Jean Cattley in November 2007 and has his belt stolen by the Mantis in December, who is booked against him at Winter Epiphany.
